image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: This visual presents a flow diagram illustrating the concept of Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (T²RL). It highlights the process of verifying pseudo-labels generated through majority voting, emphasizing the importance of accurate sampled predictions and estimated rewards. The diagram includes key components such as the verifier, which utilizes external tools to enhance the reliability of predictions. Additionally, it showcases comparative results across various benchmarks, indicating significant improvements in accuracy when employing T²RL. The visual effectively communicates the methodology and benefits of integrating verification in reinforcement learning to mitigate issues related to spurious pseudo-labels.
